text:
Two tests are carried out to identify an aqueous solution of X.
test 1
Aqueous sodium hydroxide is added and a blue precipitate is produced.
test 2
Dilute nitric acid is added followed by aqueous silver nitrate and a white
precipitate is produced.
What is X?
A
copper carbonate
B
copper chloride
iron(III) carbonate
C
D
iron(III) chloride
subject: Chemistry
